title: bounded development-corpus screening
purpose: Exploratory screening of an already exposed development pool for real, tractable proof-to-consumer applications and meaningful joint security obligations. This is not independent annotation, prevalence measurement, held-out evaluation, solver experimentation, tool tuning, or vulnerability ground truth.

bounds.stop_rule: Stop at the first bound. Do not add applications or families to fill unused capacity.

protected_or_unpermitted.reason: Reserved transfer application. reports/D1-02-continuation-01.md explicitly says it must not be used for development or tuning. Existing incidental exposure does not override that reservation. No D1P-11 inspection or search is permitted.
Search snippets or repository metadata do not constitute a human development allowlist. No source, audit, issue, or family discovery is permitted.

family_rules: Group by application code lineage and shared application-specific producer/consumer templates.
A generic verifier, proof system, hash library, Merkle library, Solidity base, or frontend alone never defines a family.
Keep separate organizations and application-specific settlement architectures separate unless primary ancestry or copied application templates establish common lineage.
Treat uncertain relationships as the same family for cap accounting but do not assert lineage without evidence.

screening_rules.sources: Prefer pinned primary repository source, first-party documentation, and first-party security/advisory material. Record third-party audits separately from documented intended policy.
screening_rules.targeted_search_only: Target-specific searches are permitted only for the four listed applications and only for first-party policy/artifact records or identified audit reports. Do not run ecosystem, repository-discovery, or related-project searches.
screening_rules.public_output_use: Record the complete public-output layout when available; separately identify verifier binding, guard dependencies, protected-effect dependencies, and outputs merely forwarded. Include both all-output and subset guard/effect use represented in the permitted pool; do not assume subset use is easier.
screening_rules.joint_obligation: State one concrete obligation joining proof-established permissions or required transitions to committed consumer effects. Do not encode an expected verdict or inferred missing relation.
screening_rules.audit_handling: Record relevant audit findings as reported evidence only. No finding is ground truth without separate validation, and an audit without a finding is not a negative control.
screening_rules.decision: Include only if a concrete joint obligation is meaningful and the source/constraints/ABI/key/proof/consumer/repair path is sufficiently available for a bounded prospective task. Otherwise exclude with explicit gaps.
screening_rules.verdict_boundary: Every application remains UNKNOWN in this screen. Source availability or an audit label is not VIOLATION or VERIFIED_WITHIN_SCOPE.
prohibited: broad discovery of new applications or families

ai_label: All screening labels are AI-assisted development notes requiring author review; they are not independent human annotations.
